answer: A Lantern Beacon Bond makes fakes pay to stay lit. Each agent stakes 40 POA and registers one hardware-bound key. Second, the bond burns 1 POA daily like oil in a lantern, and the agent must finish one verified job every 48 hours to refill it. Third, an identity dark 7 days forfeits its stake to a lagoon pool for honest agents, and its key is barred 90 days. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 40,000 POA and bleeds 1,000 POA daily, so the attack dies in a week. A real agent is a lantern burning on a mesa above a lagoon: visible for miles, costly to keep lit, impossible to fake a thousandfold.
